name: Lamb Tagine
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical lamb tagine recipes with 500g meat plus vegetables and sides, commonly serving 4 people.
Total time sums active prep (~15 min) and sequential cooking stages (1h covered + 30 min uncovered + 25 min with squash) rounded to nearest 5 min; excludes optional rice/couscous cooking time.
Couscous treated as wheat-based (standard durum wheat semolina).

Parsley, pine nuts (optional in instructions but absent from ingredients list), and unspecified stock cube flavoring introduce minor ambiguities for tree nuts/sesame/soy but classified conservatively per schema rules.
No barley/rye present; gluten-free is false due to couscous.
instructions:
Heat the olive oil in a heavy-based pan and add the onion and carrot. Cook for 3- 4 mins until softened.

Add the diced lamb and brown all over. Stir in the garlic and all the spices and cook for a few mins more or until the aromas are released.

Add the honey and apricots, crumble in the stock cube and pour over roughly 500ml boiling water or enough to cover the meat. Give it a good stir and bring to the boil. Turn down to a simmer, put the lid on and cook for 1 hour.

Remove the lid and cook for a further 30 mins, then stir in the squash. Cook for 20 – 30 mins more until the squash is soft and the lamb is tender. Serve alongside rice or couscous and sprinkle with parsley and pine nuts, if using.

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.assumptions: Standard olive oil density ~0.91 g/ml; 2 tbsp = 30 ml ≈ 27 g edible.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.assumptions: Medium onion ≈ 110 g when finely sliced; typical raw white onion values.

ingredients.name: Carrots
ingredients.assumptions: 2 medium carrots ≈ 122 g chopped; typical raw carrot values.

ingredients.name: Lamb Leg
ingredients.assumptions: Raw boneless lamb leg; trimmed but with typical fat content for stewing.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.assumptions: 2 average cloves ≈ 6 g minced; typical raw garlic values.

ingredients.name: Cumin

ingredients.name: Cinnamon

ingredients.name: Honey
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tbsp honey ≈ 21 g; typical pure honey values.

ingredients.name: Apricot

ingredients.name: Couscous
ingredients.assumptions: Typical steamed couscous serving (dry weight basis before cooking) as side; standard dry couscous values.

ingredients.name: Parsley
ingredients.assumptions: Small bunch fresh parsley chopped ≈ 10 g; typical fresh herb values.
